analogy.rationale: ESRRB/ESRRG are orphan nuclear receptors with limited expression in these cell lines, so agonists should elicit little transcriptional change; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor agonists, especially estrogen receptor agonists, which share structural and coactivator biology but also depend on receptor expression.
